title: Soft Metric Spaces via Soft Elements: Topology Across Parameter-Cardinalities and Fixed-Point Theory
summary: A soft set $(F,E)$ determines the selection space $\SE(F)=\prod_{e\in E}F(e)$. This paper studies two natural structures on that space. For at most countable $E$, the series metric $\dPi$ induces the product topology. For arbitrary $E$, the sup metric $\dsup$ induces uniform convergence. We prove that these metric spaces are complete exactly when all fibres are complete. We then compare global contractions with coordinatewise contractions and give counterexamples when coordinate separability or a uniform contractive bound is absent.
